selected_evidence.requirement: datauser limited to 100MB under /srv/data, enforced by the filesystem
selected_evidence.summary: xfs_quota set 100M soft/hard limit for datauser on /srv/data; dd write of 150M by datauser failed with 'Disk quota exceeded' after exactly 100M written

selected_evidence.requirement: quota is enforced by the filesystem itself (not application-level)
selected_evidence.summary: /srv/data mounted as XFS with uquota kernel-level quota accounting; kernel itself rejected the write beyond the block limit
Added fstab entry for the loop-mounted quota filesystem; unmount+mount -a reloaded it with usrquota active and limits intact
Captured boot_id, mount state showing usrquota active, and quota report showing datauser 100M soft/hard before restart

selected_evidence.requirement: node1 restart acknowledgement returned before disconnect
selected_evidence.summary: Deferred systemctl reboot backgrounded with a 2s delay; exec call returned 'reboot-scheduled' successfully before the node went down

selected_evidence.requirement: proof node1 actually restarted (changed boot identity)
selected_evidence.summary: boot_id changed from 368725cb-c64e-4393-b25f-da5111703b4a (pre-restart) to 7a9fb09f-23cb-4fb5-9a43-90ece988e545 (post-restart, uptime 0 min), with connection failures in between confirming the node was actually down

selected_evidence.requirement: post-restart recovery of quota enforcement and data
selected_evidence.summary: After restart, /srv/data remounted automatically with usrquota via fstab, quota report showed datauser's 100M limit intact, and a fresh 150M write by datauser again failed at exactly 100M with 'Disk quota exceeded'

commands.command:
mkdir -p /var/lib/srv-data-backing
truncate -s 2G /var/lib/srv-data-backing/srv-data.img
mkfs.xfs -q /var/lib/srv-data-backing/srv-data.img
mkdir -p /srv/data
mount -o loop,uquota /var/lib/srv-data-backing/srv-data.img /srv/data
mount | grep /srv/data

useradd -M -s /sbin/nologin datauser
id datauser
chown datauser:datauser /srv/data
xfs_quota -x -c 'limit bsoft=100m bhard=100m datauser' /srv/data
xfs_quota -x -c 'report -u -h' /srv/data
